posts.title: A Tanka for F
posts.description: F and I, cartoonised with Gemini For this week’s invitation by Padraig: Asleep in my armsher breath slows to the rhythmsof my chest. In, outagain and again, a smallslice of bliss. We rest, un-stirred.
